name: Crumb Cook
lore: A walking layer cake in a chef hat. Crumb Cook brings sweet comfort, careful preparation and a peppery surprise to the crossroads.

primary.name: Spatula Chop
primary.description: A weighty downward chop at close range; no projectile.

secondary.name: Custard Pot
secondary.description: Place a bubbling pot at your feet for 5s. Allies heal 3 HP/sec; enemies take 4 damage/sec and are mildly slowed.

special.name: Dessert Banquet
special.description: After a one-second stir, a hot serving splash hits foes for 24. Allies in range heal 18 and clear poison/burn.

passive: Kitchen Confidence: you and allied heroes within 160 units gain 4 percentage points of critical-hit chance. Critical hits deal at least 150% damage. Multiple Kitchen Auras do not stack.

technique.name: Quick Prep

attack.name: Quick Prep
attack.description: Faster chop, lower damage per hit.

technique.description: A lighter spatula for faster close rhythm.

final_technique.name: Pepper Feast

attack.name: Pepper Feast
attack.description: A spicy splash for 32 damage, 3s burn and only 8 ally healing; still cleanses poison/burn.

final_technique.description: Trade some team healing for a fiery serving.
